strings.name: Shah Rukh Khan
strings.summary: Shah Rukh Khan moved from theatre and television in Delhi into Hindi cinema. Early antihero roles drew attention before romantic films built an international audience. His work ranges from Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge to Chak De! India and My Name Is Khan, engaging with family, belonging and social identity. He also works in production and visual effects, and began a renewed phase of action filmmaking in 2023.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected chronology extends to the September 2025 National Film Awards ceremony. Publicity and release plans for later films are not treated as proof of completed release.
strings.influence.rationale: Expanded international audiences for Hindi cinema through sustained acting and production, influencing Indian pop culture and cultural identity in the diaspora.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Early education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Attended Hansraj College, University of Delhi, and participated in Delhi theatre
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Expanding Hindi cinema’s audience
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Reached audiences in India and its diaspora through romances, action films and works addressing social questions.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Combining acting and production
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Co-founded Red Chillies Entertainment with Gauri Khan and received a National Film Award for Best Actor for Jawan in 2025.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Receives the National Film Award for Best Actor
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Received the 71st National Film Award for Best Actor for the 2023 film Jawan, sharing the category with an actor honored for another film.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Receives Locarno’s career achievement award
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Received the Pardo alla Carriera at the 77th Locarno Film Festival and discussed his acting career with audiences.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Begins a new phase with three films
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Pathaan, Jawan and Dunki were released, ending a period of several years without a new leading film role.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Stars in My Name Is Khan
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Appeared with Kajol as a Muslim man living in the United States in a story about prejudice, identity and family.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Stars in Chak De! India
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Played a coach of India’s women’s hockey team in a sports story about trust, teamwork and social prejudice.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Co-founds Red Chillies
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Established Red Chillies Entertainment with Gauri Khan, developing production, distribution and visual-effects work.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Appears in Devdas
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Worked with Sanjay Leela Bhansali, playing the protagonist of the classic novel in a musical melodrama.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Stars in Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
strings.timeline.event-08.text: His romance with Kajol connected European and Punjabi settings and became central to the development of his international audience.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Draws attention through antihero roles
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Played dangerous, obsessive characters in Baazigar and Darr, expanding beyond conventional romantic leading roles.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Enters cinema with Deewana
strings.timeline.event-10.text: His first released film was commercially successful, helping him move from television into leading Hindi-film roles.
strings.timeline.event-11.title: Reaches television audiences through Fauji
strings.timeline.event-11.text: Played army trainee Abhimanyu Rai, then appeared in other television series, building experience for his film career.
strings.timeline.event-12.title: Born in New Delhi
strings.timeline.event-12.text: Grew up in Delhi, participating in sports and drama at school and pursuing further acting experience during college.
